description: This file defines private structures, macros, and includes related to WPA control manager in a wireless LAN context. It contains licensing information, structure definitions, and function-like macros for handling WPA control interfaces.

methods.name: CALL_MGR
methods.description: Macro to call a handler function on the WPA control manager if it exists.

methods.name: CALL_MGR_NA
methods.description: Macro to call a handler function without additional arguments if it exists.

methods.name: CALL_MGR_RET
methods.description: Macro to call a handler function with arguments and handle return value, setting default error codes.

methods.name: CALL_MGR_RET_NA
methods.description: Macro to call a handler function without additional arguments and handle return value.
